shippers.name: Thrive Market
shippers.highlight: Largest vetted organic online store, no artificial anything
shippers.why: Every product is screened against a long banned-ingredients list. Membership model means lower prices on the same clean brands you'd buy retail.
shippers.howItWorks: Annual membership unlocks 30–40% savings on thousands of organic and non-GMO grocery items. Ships nationwide in 2–5 days.

shippers.name: ButcherBox
shippers.highlight: 100% grass-fed, humanely raised, no factory farms
shippers.why: All beef is grass-fed and grass-finished, pork is heritage-breed, chicken is organic and free-range. No antibiotics or added hormones, ever.
shippers.howItWorks: Monthly curated or custom box of meat and seafood, frozen and shipped nationwide. Skip or cancel anytime.

shippers.name: Misfits Market
shippers.highlight: Organic produce boxes, 40% below grocery prices
shippers.why: Rescues cosmetically imperfect organic produce that would otherwise be wasted. Same nutrition, lower price.
shippers.howItWorks: Customize a weekly box of organic produce and grocery. Skip any week. Ships to most of the US.

shippers.name: FarmBox Direct
shippers.highlight: Partners with actual small farms, includes farm notes
shippers.why: Sources from real small and mid-size organic farms across the US. Each box includes a note about which farms grew what.
shippers.howItWorks: Weekly or bi-weekly box, choose all-fruit, all-veggie, or mixed. Sizes for one person up to a family.

shippers.name: Vital Choice
shippers.highlight: Wild-caught seafood, tested for mercury & contaminants
shippers.why: The gold standard for wild Alaskan salmon and seafood. Every batch is third-party tested for purity.
shippers.howItWorks: One-time orders or subscriptions. Frozen at peak freshness, shipped overnight.

shippers.name: Good Chop
shippers.highlight: 100% American sourced, no imports, no factory farms
shippers.why: Every cut comes from independent American farmers and ranchers. No imported meat, no factory farms.
shippers.howItWorks: Customize a monthly box of meat and seafood. Includes butcher cards from real farms.

shippers.name: Sun Basket
shippers.highlight: USDA organic meal kits, zero artificial ingredients
shippers.why: Only meal-kit company with consistent USDA Organic certification. Designed by a chef and a nutritionist.
shippers.howItWorks: Choose recipes weekly. Pre-portioned organic ingredients shipped chilled, ready to cook in 20–35 minutes.

shippers.name: Azure Standard
shippers.highlight: Best value bulk organic, community drop-point network
shippers.why: Family-owned, certified organic since 1971. Massive selection of bulk organic grains, flours, beans, and pantry items at wholesale prices.
shippers.howItWorks: Order monthly, pick up at a local Azure drop point or get home delivery in select areas. Save 20–50% buying in bulk.

shippers.name: Radiant Life
shippers.highlight: Organ meats, raw dairy, ancestral nutrition
shippers.why: Sources traditional, nutrient-dense foods that are hard to find anywhere else — pasture-raised organ meats, real fermented foods, raw dairy products.
shippers.howItWorks: Order online, shipped frozen or shelf-stable depending on the product.

shippers.name: Once Again Nut Butter
shippers.highlight: Worker-owned co-op, Regenerative Organic Certified, zero additives
shippers.why: Worker-owned cooperative since 1976. Just nuts (and salt if you want it) — no palm oil, no emulsifiers, no sugar.
shippers.howItWorks: Order direct or find in stores. Pantry-stable, ships nationwide.

shippers.name: Primal Pastures
shippers.highlight: Only widely available soy-free, corn-free pasture-raised poultry
shippers.why: Family farm in California. Chicken raised on pasture without soy or corn feed — extremely rare in commercial poultry.
shippers.howItWorks: Order online, frozen, shipped nationwide in insulated boxes.

shippers.name: Paleovalley
shippers.highlight: Cleanest meat snacks, naturally fermented, third-party tested
shippers.why: 100% grass-fed beef sticks naturally fermented (not chemically cured). No sugar, no soy, no junk.
shippers.howItWorks: One-time orders or subscribe and save. Shelf-stable, ships nationwide.
